title: 连 O 也/都 V (even V O)
longExplanation: even V O. Pinyin: lián O yě/ dōu V

examples.sentence: 你太厉害了，连中文报纸都看得懂。
examples.romanization: nǐ tài lìhai le， lián Zhōngwén bàozhǐ dōu kàn dé dǒng。
examples.translation: You are so awesome/skilled you can even understand Chinese newspapers.

title: 连 S 也/都 V (even S V)
longExplanation: even S V. Pinyin: lián S yě/ dōu V

examples.sentence: 如果连你自己都不喜欢自己，又怎么能让别人喜欢你呢？
examples.romanization: rúguǒ lián nǐ zìjǐ dōu bù xǐhuan zìjǐ， yòu zěnme néng ràng biéren xǐhuan nǐ ne？
examples.translation: If even you don’t like yourself, how can you let others like you?

examples.sentence: 他一定有重要的事找你，否则不会打这么多次电话来。
examples.romanization: tā yīdìng yǒu zhòngyào de shì zhǎo nǐ， fǒuzé bùhuì dǎ zhème duōcì diànhuà lái。
examples.translation: He must have something important to see (lit. look for) you about, otherwise he won't call so many times.

title: 无论/不管 Q 都 (regardless of Q)
longExplanation: regardless of Q. Pinyin: wúlùn/ bùguǎn Q dōu

title: 同时…… (at the same time, …)
longExplanation: at the same time, …. Pinyin: tóngshí……

examples.sentence: 阅读能丰富你的知识，同时还会丰富你的情感。
examples.romanization: yuèdú néng fēngfù nǐ de zhīshi， tóngshí hái huì fēngfù nǐ de qínggǎn。
examples.translation: Reading can enrich your knowledge and (at the same time) [it will] enrich your affects.

title: ……的同时 (at the same time when…)
longExplanation: at the same time when…. Pinyin: …… de tóngshí

examples.sentence: 在学习汉语的同时，我还了解了中国的文化。
examples.romanization: zài xuéxí Hànyǔ de tóngshí， wǒ hái liǎojiě le Zhōngguó de wénhuà。
examples.translation: While learning Chinese (at the same time), I also learned about Chinese culture.

title: 并/并且 V (and V)
longExplanation: and V. Pinyin: bìng/ bìngqiě V

title: 再……也...... (no matter how… still…)
longExplanation: no matter how… still…. Pinyin: zài…… yě......

examples.sentence: 事情已经发生了，你再后悔也无法改变，别伤心了。
examples.romanization: shìqing yǐjīng fāshēng le， nǐ zài hòuhuǐ yě wúfǎ gǎibiàn， bié shāngxīn le。
examples.translation: Things have already happened, no matter how you regret it you (still) won’t be able to change it, don't be sad.

examples.sentence: 关于这次调查计划，经理说有很多不清楚的地方。
examples.romanization: guānyú zhè cì diàochá jìhuà， jīnglǐ shuō yǒu hěn duō bùqīngchu de dìfang。
examples.translation: About the survey plan, the manager said that there are many unclear places.

title: M + M + (N) + 都 (every N)
longExplanation: every N. Pinyin: M + M + (N) + dōu

examples.sentence: 件件小事都应该被看成是一次学习的机会。
examples.romanization: jiàn jiàn xiǎoshì dōu yīnggāi bèi kànchéng shì yīcì xuéxí de jīhuì。
examples.translation: Each small thing should (all) be seen as an opportunity to learn.

title: 相反，…… (on the other hand, …)
longExplanation: on the other hand, …. Pinyin: xiāngfǎn，……

title: 和/跟 N 相反 (to be the opposite of N)
shortExplanation: to be the opposite of N
longExplanation: to be the opposite of N. Pinyin: hé/ gēn N xiāngfǎn

examples.sentence: 调查结果和他们想的几乎完全相反。
examples.romanization: diàochájiéguǒ hé tāmen xiǎng de jīhūwánquán xiāngfǎn。
examples.translation: The results of the survey are almost completely the opposite of what they thought.

title: 大概/也许 V/A (probably/perhaps V/A)
longExplanation: probably/perhaps V/A. Pinyin: dàgài/ yěxǔ V/A
